criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Implement suitable classification models and consistent preprocessing for the liver status target.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Use stratified cross-validation or an appropriate validation strategy without test leakage.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare models using class-sensitive metrics and explain the trade-offs, especially recall and false negatives.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Explain feature contributions with appropriate methods; do not imply causation or clinical validity.

criteria.name: Risk Scoring & Patient Grouping
criteria.guidance: If producing risk scores or groups, validate calibration and explain thresholds as illustrative unless clinically validated.
